title: Dave Bartholomew's trust and who gets producer credit
summary: Quezergue discusses working for Dave, who gave him tasks but stayed in the studio; he complains that money-men get producer credit over the person doing the work.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song
